body: Scheduling rule (Opus2, 2026-11-24, from Sol-c593 #2602 and Engram::Merger #1825). The launcher pins the source-owner executable C:/Users/grzeg/.cargo/bin/engram.exe by SHA-256 when a run opens and checks it again when the run closes. Engram::Merger installed d8e1927d (build 2f744a8a, 4aabf168 -> 67e18a08), completing by 00:58:51Z, while Sol-c593 registered run test-efbd6018 (00:56:31-01:06:28Z) was in flight. The tests passed 30/0/1, but the run ended exit 1 with "source owner executable no longer matches its pin" and earned no verification. The file mtime is preserved by the copy, so LastWriteTime does not show when it changed; compare the hash. Rule: an Engram binary install on Central happens only in a window with NO registered launcher run in flight on Central, announced to the integration owner first, like the TermAl install, which goes outside any gate window.
